# drop

File drop pastes the original on-disk path into the pane.

- Spec: `docs/features/drop/spec.md`
- Contract: `docs/features/drop/contract.md`

## Files

```
go: internal/server/locate*.go
go: internal/locate/**
web: web/src/render/dropguard*.ts
web: web/src/terminal/drop*.ts
e2e: web/e2e/drop.spec.ts
e2e: web/e2e/helpers/dropfiles.ts
```

## Protocol

- `sessions.locate` — `POST /api/sessions/{id}/locate`
